{{Quote|That was&mdash;that was Tuvar, wasn't it? From Independent Voice News?|[[Kandra Nilitz]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
'''Tuvar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] who was on assignment for [[Independent Voice News]] at the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Rotunda]] during the [[Plan Delta|Jedi coup of the Galactic Alliance]]. While reporting the incident in the building, he broke through a barrier until he was stun shot by security forces to prevent the automated laser from triggering in the vicinity.
